mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tenant_usage_monthly ( tenant_key, usage_month_date, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, estimated_cost, trace_id, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantKey}, #{usageMonthDate}, #{requestCount}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{toolCalls}, #{estimatedCost}, #{traceToken}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_key, usage_month_date, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, estimated_cost, trace_id, updated_at FROM tb_tenant_usage_monthly WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND usage_month_date = #{usageMonthDate}

SELECT tenant_key, usage_month_date, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, estimated_cost, trace_id, updated_at FROM tb_tenant_usage_monthly WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND usage_month_date >= #{fromMonthDate} AND usage_month_date <= #{toMonthDate} ORDER BY usage_month_date ASC

SELECT tenant_key, usage_month_date, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, tool_calls, estimated_cost, trace_id, updated_at FROM tb_tenant_usage_monthly ORDER BY tenant_key ASC, usage_month_date ASC
